# OpenTimelineIO fixtures

Official sample timelines are copied from OpenTimelineIO v0.17.0
(`AcademySoftwareFoundation/OpenTimelineIO`, Apache-2.0):

- `simple_cut.otio`
- `transition.otio`
- `clip_example.otio`
- `multitrack.otio`
- `nested_example.otio`
- `generator_reference_test.otio`

`kdenlive_style.otio` is a small cross-editor fixture in the same JSON family
(Timeline.1 / Track.1 / Clip.1 / Marker.2 / ExternalReference.1). It is not an
official Kdenlive export.
